messages:
Alex Li: Thanks for joining today's all-hands — follow-up thread for action items and clarifications. Dropping notes below; owners please ack and add estimates.

Sarah K: Ack. On SLA phrasing: avoid 'guaranteed latency' wording. Recommend 'target latency' with explicit availability SLA. I'll draft language by EOW.

Ben Ortega: I'll own the Dedicated v2 rollout runbook. Syncing with infra + onboardings, will add canary steps and auto-fallback. Creating INF-4321 now.

Maria Chen: Private/on-prem packaging: MVP aimed end of Q2 but need legal signoff on export controls and KMS work. I'll update timeline doc after legal sync.

Priya R: I9ll own evals & quality guardrails. Need canonical prompt sets from Product for chat, embeddings, rerank. @Alex Li confirm priority areas?

Alex Li: @Priya R priority order: 1) chat generation, 2) embeddings, 3) reranking. Use redwood/evals template, pin model versions for canaries.

Sarah K: Draft SLA copy (first pass): "Target P95 latency < 250ms for single-request gen paths; Availability 99.9% for Dedicated pools. Contract will include precise terms." Feedback?

Ben Ortega: Looks reasonable. I'll add automated fallback policy + rollback checklist to INF-4321 and schedule DR run in staging next week.

eng-bot: Recording uploaded — https://redwood.zoom.us/rec/share/abcd1234  Slides: https://drive.redwood.com/all-hands/mar-2026 (internal access)

Priya R: Question: Are model catalog pushes locked during rollouts? Do evals run against pinned versions or the latest?

Alex Li: We pin versions for canaries. Production switch only after canary success and manual approval. I'll add exact policy text to the rollout doc today.

Maria Chen: Legal question: additional NDAs/data agreements for EU Private deployments beyond current templates? @People Ops / Legal please advise.

Sarah K: I'll sync with Legal/People Ops tomorrow 10am PT and post notes here.

Alex Li: Action recap: Ben — rollout runbook & INF-4321 (canary + rollback); Maria — on-prem timeline & legal coordination; Priya — eval suites & prompt sets; Sarah — SLA wording & legal sync. Please add ETA/estimated hours to your ticket or comment here by EOD Monday.

Ben Ortega: Ack :thumbsup:

Priya R: Ack

Maria Chen: Ack

Sarah K: Ack

Alex Li: Thanks — will close this follow-up in 48h if no further asks. If you need to escalate, DM the owner or ping leadership in #product.
